title: populus balsamifera var. virginiana
intro: Populus balsamifera var. virginiana, commonly known as Eastern Cottonwood, is a deciduous tree native to eastern North America. The health benefits of Eastern Cottonwood include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe coughs, and alleviate fever, while also exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant are primarily due to its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which help to relieve respiratory issues and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Eastern Cottonwood include salicin, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
